verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique immigration law firm that delivers attorney-led professional services (visa petitions, green cards, naturalization). It is not a software product with a UI, so asking for API parity with a UI is a category error for this kind of offering. The 404 probes for OpenAPI and llms.txt fit this but do not change the axis assessment, and nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any software interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
